verdict.rationale: Productboard's REST API lets developers create feedback with customer attribution and associate it with existing users and companies through dedicated relationship endpoints. That ties submissions to accounts, but only through a backend integration you build yourself. Nothing shows a client-side identify call, SSO, or widget mechanism that automatically recognizes a logged-in end user at submission time. Missing for 10: automatic logged-in user identification at submission (SDK/widget identify or SSO), documented user-matching behavior (e.g., by email or external ID), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
